ownership.quote: Pipeshift helps engineering teams run real-time inference in production. We offer optimized runtimes to meet latency/throughput SLAs, paired with infrastructure orchestration that auto-scales and routes workloads across clusters and regions at cost.

stage.note: The round was led by Y Combinator (accelerator) and SenseAI Ventures, announced Jan 2025; no later priced round found.

total_funding_usd.basis: Only disclosed round is the $2.5M seed; matches multiple press reports (citybiz, YourStory, Entrackr, The Economic Times) of the same round.

last_round.quote: The round was led by Y Combinator and SenseAI Ventures, with participation from Arka Venture Labs, Good News Ventures, Nivesha Ventures, Astir VC, GradCapital, MyAsiaVC and angels like Kulveer Taggar (CEO of Zuess), Umur Cubukcu (CEO of Ubicloud and former Head of PostgreSQL at Azure), and Krishna Mehra.

note: YC S24 (Summer 2024, status Active per YC directory), website https://pipeshift.com matches the card's provider domain, confirming this is the same company. Founded by Pranav Reddy, Arko Chattopadhyay (CEO) and Enrique Ferrao. Raised a $2.5M seed round (announced Jan 2025) led by Y Combinator and SenseAI Ventures. Positions itself as an MLOps/inference platform for open-source GenAI models (LLMs, vision, audio, image) across cloud/on-prem GPUs, not a general-purpose code sandbox; the site's 'Sandbox' is a model-API playground, per the provider card's own caveats. No revenue/ARR or employee count publicly disclosed as of check date.
